experiment.name: smt-2388-optimization-reporting
experiment.description: Compare fixed main and the SMT optimization metadata fix on ten existing SMT-LIB/MPS fixtures, two seeds each. Verify lia-opt reports model-oriented objective 7 and explicit optimal status with proof credit, preserve source feasibility verdicts and MPS objectives, and retain installed-build provenance. Reported results are not independent source validation; no timing claim.
